tools.summary: Records the pyNavis commands you run next, so Play Macro can repeat them in order.
tools.title: Record Macro

tools.summary: Runs a saved macro, one command after another. Dialogs inside its commands still ask you; click again to stop a playing macro.
tools.title: Play Macro

tools.summary: Rename, reorder, add pauses, questions or Navisworks commands to, export or import your macros.
tools.title: Manage Macros

tools.summary: Makes a ribbon button in your MyTools extension that plays a macro, with its own icon and shortcut.
tools.title: Macro to Button

tools.summary: Every saved template of every Playground report in one list, to run without dialogs, edit, duplicate, delete, export or import. Reports not built yet show as unavailable.
tools.title: Report Templates

tools.summary: Runs report templates on a model on a timetable through Windows Task Scheduler and the pyNavis command line runner, then mails or copies the results.
tools.title: Scheduled Reports

tools.summary: Makes a new ribbon button in your MyTools extension from a template or your own script, with an icon and an optional shortcut.
tools.title: Button Maker

tools.summary: Edits the scripts of your own extensions beside Navisworks, with line numbers, completion, a syntax check on save and F5 to run.
tools.title: Script Editor

tools.summary: Gives any pyNavis button or Navisworks ribbon command a keyboard shortcut, or takes one away, and warns when two commands want the same keys. Click a command, click the shortcut field, then press the keys.
tools.title: Hotkey Manager

tools.summary: Installs, updates and removes pyNavis extensions listed in your team registry. Shift+Click sets the registry.
tools.title: Extension Manager

tools.summary: Pulls the team's templates, presets, rules, shortcuts and project settings from the team folder, or pushes yours to it.
tools.title: Team Sync

tools.summary: Shows which tools are used, when and by whom, and which are never used. Opt-in, and it never records document names. Shift+Click for settings and Excel export.
tools.title: Usage Analytics

tools.status_note: Ran headless under pynavis run against a sample model; no selection: ran to the end (wrote output); result not checked by a person.
tools.summary: Checks Navisworks, pyNavis, engines, extensions, shortcuts, panels, add-ins, folders and the log, and reports what needs attention. Shift+Click copies the report as text.
tools.title: Environment Doctor

tools.summary: Sets your name, the project and company, where Playground keeps team data, the trades and trade rules, report units and the date format.
tools.title: Playground Settings

tools.summary: Converts lengths, areas, volumes and masses as you type, like 12' 6" to mm or 250 sqft in m2. Enter copies the result.
tools.title: Unit Converter
